_comment: Guided tour of the package manager. Destructive buttons are explained, never awaited.

steps.title: What is installed
steps.text: The Installed Packages page lists the packages of the current environment. Type in Filter to narrow the list by name; click a header to sort.

steps.title: Find a package
steps.text: Open Search & Install, type a name and press Enter. Results are listed newest first; select one and Install Selected asks before it installs.

steps.title: Environments
steps.text: Environments lists the conda environments. Create, clone, remove, export to a YAML file or import one. Removing asks first.

steps.title: Channels
steps.text: Channels are where packages come from. Add one by name or URL, or remove the selected one.

steps.title: The log
steps.text: Everything the package manager does is written to the Operation Log, with the time. Refresh All reloads the lists.
